speaker: mission_control
english: You're on course for {target}. Take it easy.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vuestra alineación es buena. Sin prisas.
english: Your alignment is good. No hurry.

speaker: mission_control
english: Perfect speed. That's how it's done.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Os acercáis a {close_ms} metros por segundo. Perfecto.
english: You're closing at {close_ms} meters per second. Perfect.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: {close_ms} metros por segundo. Justo lo que queremos.
english: {close_ms} meters per second. Just what we want.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Casi estáis. Despacio y sin sustos.
english: Almost there. Slow and no scares.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Os vemos a {dist_m} metros. Todo bien.
english: We see you at {dist_m} meters. All good.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Copiado, {dist_m} metros. Despacio en el último tramo.
english: Copy, {dist_m} meters. Easy on the last stretch.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: {dist_m} metros. La alineación se ve bien.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Todo listo para el atraque, {dist_m} metros.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Os seguimos a {dist_m} metros. Buena aproximación.
english: We follow you at {dist_m} meters. Good approach.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: {dist_m} metros del objetivo. Todo en orden.
english: {dist_m} meters from the target. All in order.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Objetivo a {dist_m} metros. Os acercáis a {close_ms} metros por segundo.
english: Target at {dist_m} meters. Closing at {close_ms} m/s.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: {target} a {dist_m} metros. Velocidad de acercamiento, {close_ms} metros por segundo.

speaker: mission_control
english: {target} at {dist_m} meters. Line up the ports.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vais a {close_ms} metros por segundo hacia {target}. Frenad un poco.
english: You're closing on {target} at {close_ms} m/s. Slow down a bit.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: {close_ms} metros por segundo es demasiado. Frenad antes de llegar.
english: {close_ms} m/s is too much. Brake before you get there.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ojo, vais muy rápido hacia {target}. {close_ms} metros por segundo.
english: Careful, you're going fast toward {target}. {close_ms} m/s.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: {target} a {dist_m} metros, y os acercáis muy despacio. Paciencia.
english: {target} at {dist_m} meters, closing very slowly. Patience.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Velocidad de acercamiento casi cero. Así se llega, pero tarde.
english: Closing speed almost zero. You'll get there, just late.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Os alejáis del objetivo. Dad la vuelta.
english: You're drifting away from the target. Turn around.

speaker: mission_control
english: {target} is getting further away. Check your heading.

speaker: mission_control
english: {vessel}, {dist_m} meters to go. Take it easy.

speaker: mission_control
english: Contact any moment now. Hold still.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya casi tocáis. Nada de movimientos bruscos.

speaker: kerbal_a
english: We're very close to the port.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Frenad un poco antes del contacto.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Cuidado con la velocidad de cierre.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Acoplamiento completo. Ahora hay {crew} kerbals a bordo.
english: Docking complete. Now there are {crew} kerbals aboard.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Dos naves, ahora una. Bien hecho.
english: Two ships, now one. Well done.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Dos naves, ahora una. {parts} piezas en total.
english: Two ships, now one. {parts} parts in total.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Y ahora, a no chocar con nada.
english: And now, let's not hit anything.

speaker: mission_control
english: We see you clear, {vessel}. Safe travels.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Os vemos separados. Mantened la distancia.
english: We see you separated. Keep your distance.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Separados. Mantened la distancia, por favor.

speaker: mission_control
english: Received. You're clear of the port.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: La nave tiene ahora {parts} piezas. Todas en su sitio, esperamos.
english: The ship has {parts} parts now. All in place, we hope.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ahora sois {parts} piezas. Que no se suelte ninguna.
english: You're {parts} parts now. Don't lose any.

speaker: mission_control
english: Take it easy as you pull away.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Comprobad el puerto y la estructura.
english: Check the port and the structure.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Puerto a la vista. Empezamos la aproximación.
english: Port in sight. Starting the approach.

speaker: mission_control
english: We see you closing in. Speed?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Aproximación en curso. Despacio y recto.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Recibido. Revisad que no falte nada.
english: Copy. Check that nothing is missing.

speaker: mission_control
english: Hard contact. Are you all right?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Entendido. Comprobad el puerto y seguid.
english: Understood. Check the port and carry on.

speaker: mission_control
english: Check that it's all still attached.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ese contacto ha sido brusco. ¿Estáis bien?
english: That contact was rough. Are you okay?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Copiado. Más despacio la próxima vez.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tratad el puerto de atraque como material prestado.
english: Treat the docking port like borrowed equipment.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Las correcciones pequeñas ahorran propelente y disculpas.
english: Small corrections save both propellant and apologies.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Mirad la esfera de navegación antes de seguir las vistas por la ventanilla.
english: Check the navball before chasing the view out the window.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No hay premio al atraque más rápido.
english: There is no prize for the fastest docking.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Mantened una velocidad de aproximación suave.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Igualad el movimiento antes de preocuparos por quedar elegantes.
english: Match the motion before you worry about looking graceful.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: El puerto de destino es un apretón de manos, no una diana.
english: The target port is a handshake, not a dartboard.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Un poco de paciencia cuesta menos que otro anillo de atraque.
english: A little patience costs less than another docking ring.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Vigilad la velocidad relativa, no solo la distancia.
english: Watch the relative velocity, not just the distance.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Esas ráfagas de RCS sirven para dirigir, no para aplaudir.
english: Those RCS puffs count as steering, not applause.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Siempre podéis retroceder y volver a alinear.
english: You can always back away and line up again.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Guardad el tonel de victoria para otra misión.
english: Save the victory roll for a different mission.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Dejad que la alineación se estabilice entre correcciones.
english: Let the alignment settle between corrections.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: El equipo de mantenimiento agradecería una llegada tranquila.
english: The maintenance team would appreciate a quiet arrival.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Dejad que se calme el bamboleo antes de celebrarlo.
english: Let the wobble settle before celebrating.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Comprobad la conexión antes de abrir nada.
english: Check the connection before opening anything.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Un objeto suelto menos que seguir para Seguimiento.
english: That is one less loose object for Tracking to follow.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: El anillo de atraque se ha ganado el sueldo.
english: The docking ring has earned its keep.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Apuntad qué escotilla lleva a cada sitio.
english: Make a note of which hatch leads where.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ya puede alguien guardar la tabla de alineación.
english: Someone can put the alignment chart away now.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tened a mano la siguiente lista de comprobaciones.
english: Keep the next checklist within reach.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Pondremos una estrellita junto a esa maniobra.
english: We will put a small star beside that maneuver.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Los ingenieros están revisando las cifras con mucho entusiasmo.
english: The engineers are inspecting the numbers very enthusiastically.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ese es el tipo de contacto del que nos gusta oír hablar.
english: That is the sort of contact we like to hear about.
